source: Mirrors DEDICATED_TIERS / SHARED_TIERS in src/turbofit_runtime/fit_check.py; canonical publisher: src/turbofit_runtime/fit_ladders.py.
policy: Two separate ladders, not one: the dedicated (VRAM) ladder runs dense models; the unified (CPU/Mac) ladder runs MoE only, because dense does not run well on unified memory. Both converge on Qwen 3.8 Flash Next at 64 GB — the only MoE rung on the dense side. Top of the unified ladder: DeepSeek V4.1 (1017), above Flash Next (engine pending). The Fit List IS the fallback chain: serve auto walks down the chain on OOM/timeout. Cross-cutting rules for every rung: (1) MTP on whenever available; (2) mind the power bill (kWh/hour) — IQ3_S is lossless, so do not push a heavier / higher-draw quant past it (32 GB and 48 GB both stay on Qwen 3.8 27B GSQ-RCO @ IQ3_S).

8-11gb.note: dense ternary GGUF (Q2); sizes PTQ1_0 5.95 GB / PQ2_0 7.21 GB; prism-llama.cpp; MTP on

24-63gb.note: near-lossless; 262K at 24 GB; MTP on; power bill stays on IQ3_S (no heavier quant)

64gb+.note: MoE; both ladders converge on Flash Next; MTP on

unified.label: Ladder 2 — Unified (CPU / Apple Silicon, MoE only — no dense)

8-15gb.note: Colibri int2 streams experts from disk/RAM so the card stays free; TQ2_0 GGUF is the llama.cpp fallback

16-23gb.note: new MoE, MTP on; LFM2.5 24B-A2B Q4_K_M (13.5 GB) also lands in this band

24-31gb.note: new MoE, MTP on; Nemotron Bolt 74B-A9B (24GB build, 20.5 GB) is the alternative

32-47gb.note: new MoE; Qwen 3.6 at UD-Q5_K_M (25.2 GB) is the 262K alternative

48-63gb.note: highest-fidelity 35B-A3B that still fits below 64 GB

64gb+.note: Strata split engine on unified memory
